name: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
summary: Daejeon science and engineering university where freshmen enter without a major and choose one in year two; most courses are taught in English.

ib.text: No minimum IB score is published. Send IB results (predicted grades give a conditional place until finals); strong maths and science is encouraged. An English test or exemption is needed.

programmes.name: Undergraduate entry (major chosen in year two)
programmes.about: You enter KAIST without declaring a major and explore STEM fields in year one, then choose a department from the natural sciences, life science, engineering, AI and business colleges with no extra admission step.
programmes.ib: Maths and science results are weighed most; the guide does not set a minimum IB score or required subjects.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic document review led by maths and science results; an online interview only if KAIST asks. Criteria are not published. Round 2 gives a September 2027 start.

notes: The guide says all international students receive full financial support covering tuition and living expenses; the cost page shows the tuition that is waived, without a price year.
Round 1 (October) applicants can choose a Fall 2027 start as well as a Spring 2027 one, provided they graduate high school by 31 August 2027; Round 2 is September 2027 only.
Admitted students cannot defer enrolment, the USD 80 application fee cannot be waived except through the fee-waiver programme, and the round cannot be changed once the fee is paid.
